newsitem.title: USA: Emery awarded five-year Rockwell Int. contract.
newsitem.headline: Emery awarded five-year Rockwell Int. contract.

text.p: Emery Worldwide has been awarded a five-year contract to handle all the international transportation and logistics programs for Rockwell International Corporation, the carrier announced in a statement.
Rockwell international air freight subcommittee chairman Steve Enlow, said this recent contract award covers a full range of transportation and logistics functions.
Rockwell, who traditionally signed only two-year contracts with its suppliers, decided to go with a five-year contract based on its past experiences with the company, he said.
